# The Fourth Pillar

<!-- STEP id="beside-three-pillars" -->
## Keeping People Informed

Citizens cannot judge a government's work if they do not know about it. Newspapers, news channels and social media platforms keep people informed about developments around the world.

<!-- STEP id="voice-of-the-masses" -->
## A Voice of the People

The media also serves as a voice of the masses. It raises issues concerning the public and helps to resolve them through the right channels.

**Because of this role, the media is often called the fourth pillar of democracy.**
